title: Circumstellar Disks around Binary Stars in Taurus
question: What are the circumstellar disk masses of wide young binary components in Taurus, and how do primary and secondary disks compare with each other and with single stars?

data.bands: Band 6 (1.3 mm) and Band 7 (850 um), ALMA Cycle 0
data.angular_resolution: Beams ~1.1x0.74 arcsec at 1.3 mm; ~0.7-0.9x0.5 arcsec at 850 um
data.sensitivity: rms 0.15-0.20 mJy/beam at 1.3 mm; 0.35-0.40 mJy/beam at 850 um

what.value: Stellar luminosities and masses (Siess et al. 2000 grid) for sources

evidence.quote: We adopt the stellar luminosities and masses from (cite: and13) for our sources
Millimeter fluxes are single-dish fluxes at 850 $\mu$m taken from (cite: and05)

what.value: Comparison sample of single Taurus stars, with known multiples removed

evidence.quote: we used the sample in (cite: and13), and removed all known multiple sources using the list in (cite: kra11)

recipe.method: Standard CASA calibration scripts, then phase-only self-calibration on bright reference sources
Interactive clean with robust 0.5, primary-beam corrected
2D Gaussian fits in the image plane; point source if major-axis uncertainty exceeds fit size; upper limits 3 sigma
Optically thin isothermal dust: Md = F d^2 /(kappa Xg B(Td)) with 1.3 mm fluxes
assumptions: d=140 pc, Xg=0.01, kappa=2.3 cm2/g at 1.3 mm, Td=25 L^-1/4 K

recipe.goal: Statistical comparison with singles and between primaries/secondaries
recipe.method: Survival analysis with upper limits: Gehan, Peto-Peto, Peto-Prentice, EM and Buckley-James regression, Cox and Kendall tau

evidence.quote: The typical rms values achieved are 0.15-0.20 mJy/beam at 1.3 mm
The spectral index values calculated for both the primaries and secondaries have an average of 2.1

answer_key.quantity: Probability primaries and secondaries from same flux population

evidence.quote: which has a probability of only 3-4%
is 8-65% (for the Cox proportional hazard and Kendall’s tau tests)

not_stated_but_needed: Exact self-calibration solution intervals and which reference-source models
Image size, cell size and clean threshold
Primary/secondary stellar properties for IRAS 04298+2246 B and V710 Tau B details
Flagging details of the standard scripts
score_reason: Data are identified and recipe mostly described, but CASA version and several imaging parameters are missing.
rediscovery_reason: Cycle 0 data are archival, recipe largely complete, and results are numeric tables of fluxes and masses.
